title: Echoes of the Folded Time
premise: In the picturesque town of Rüterich, the residents discover a mysterious antique folding chair that, once sat in, swaps the sitter’s memories with that of a long‑lost relative. As the chair’s secret spreads, families wrestle with forgiveness, hidden loves, and a millennium‑old curse that threatens to crush the town’s bonds. The series unfolds in eight episodes, each a hand‑drawn chapter that blends heartfelt drama with pulse‑racing suspense, all told through vibrant, cinematic illustrations.
tone: Grounded, tender, but with a cinematic edge of tension and intrigue
